title: Auto Loans: which returned payment fee and which debit are examined for a bank-error waiver
content:
# Auto Loans: which returned payment fee and which debit are examined for a bank-error waiver

This rule of the Auto Loans product category at PCB applies when a returned payment fee on an auto loan is examined as a possible PCB error arising from an autopay debit. It fixes which fee and which payment are read.

## Clauses

1. **The fee.** The fee considered is the most recent returned payment fee on the loan, by posting date.
2. **The returned payment.** Its returned payment is the payment that the fee names as the payment returned.
3. **What is read from that payment.** The debit's payment method (whether it was an autopay debit from a PCB checking account), its posting date and its paying account (the checking account it was drawn on) are all read from that returned payment.

## Reading order

1. On the loan's activity, find the returned payment fees and take the one with the latest posting date.
2. Follow that fee to the payment it names.
3. From that payment, note the payment method, the posting date and the paying checking account.

## Worked case (hypothetical loan activity)

| Entry | Posted | Detail |
|---|---|---|
| Returned payment fee A | 2026-03-09 | names payment P1 |
| Returned payment fee B | 2026-06-08 | names payment P2 |
| Payment P2 | 2026-06-05 | autopay debit, drawn on checking account K |

Fee B is the most recent returned payment fee, so the payment examined is P2: an autopay debit posted 2026-06-05, drawn on account K. Fee A and payment P1 are not examined under this rule.

## Points of judgement

**Where does the paying account come from: the loan's current autopay setting or the returned payment?** From the returned payment itself; its recorded paying account is the account examined.
